Name: Extended Introduction Time
Author: AlanBF
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]NPCs have an introduction dialogue that occurs when you first meet them, but only if you meet them in the first 6 days of your game.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This mod allows you to change the amount of days.[/size][/color]

[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]IMPORTANT NOTE[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]You have to set the config before a new game.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Extended Introduction Time
Manifest.Description: Extend the time for the introduction dialogue to appear
Manifest.Author: AlanBF
